title: DOM Injection Sinks: Raw String vs TrustedHTML Policy

before.label: Unchecked innerHTML Sink
before.code: const bio = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('bio'); profileEl.innerHTML = bio; // Executes !
before.previewNote: Any attacker-controlled string flows straight into the HTML parser.

after.label: Trusted Types + DOMPurify Policy
